newsitem.title: INDIA: Mock hanging proves fatal for Indian youngster.
newsitem.headline: Mock hanging proves fatal for Indian youngster.

text.p: A 12-year-old boy in the western Indian town of Nagpur died while trying to show his younger brothers how a hanging worked, the United News of India (UNI) said on Friday.
Dhiraj Khare was imitating movie scenes on Wednesday when he snatched his sisters' "dupatta", or long scarf, tied it around his neck, tied the other end on a beam and jumped down.
He was rushed to the hospital where the doctors declared him dead.
